statement: AMD is raising Radeon GPU bundle prices ~10% (channel reports 10-15%) in July, citing tight global memory supply and rising GDDR6 prices, with GDDR6 spot prices roughly tripled since late 2025.
why: Memory supply tightness is forcing GPU price increases, a supply-side cost constraint on merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Tight GDDR6 memory supply raises GPU bill-of-materials cost and pressures merchant-GPU supply economics.

evidence.excerpt: AMD has begun informing its partners that a 10% price increase for Radeon GPU bundles is coming in July

confidence.basis: TweakTown plus corroborating Board Channels/VideoCardz channel reports; two related secondary outlets.
